headline: Lea Salonga Becomes First Filipina Honored With a Hollywood Walk of Fame Star
seoTitle: Lea Salonga Gets Hollywood Walk of Fame Star, a First for a Filipina | FMB News
seoDescription: Lea Salonga received the 2,855th Hollywood Walk of Fame star in Los Angeles on September 4, 2026, becoming the first Filipina to receive the honor.
keywords: Lea Salonga Hollywood Walk of Fame
first Filipina Hollywood Walk of Fame
deck: The Tony-winning theater icon received the 2,855th star on Hollywood Boulevard in Los Angeles, marking a verified first for a Filipina on the landmark.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Filipina theater icon Lea Salonga received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on September 4 in Los Angeles, becoming the first Filipina to receive the distinction, according to the Hollywood Chamber of Commerce and reporting after the ceremony.
Salonga's star is the 2,855th on the Walk of Fame and was dedicated in the Live Performance category at 6225 Hollywood Boulevard, in front of the Hollywood Pantages Theatre.
GMA News reported after the ceremony that Salonga had officially received the star. The Hollywood Walk of Fame's official announcement identifies her as the first Filipina to be honored with one.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Salonga's international career spans more than four decades. She is widely known for originating the role of Kim in 'Miss Saigon,' for which she won a Tony Award, and for providing the singing voices of Princess Jasmine in Disney's 'Aladdin' and Fa Mulan in 'Mulan.'

The wording of the milestone matters. The Hollywood Chamber describes Salonga as the first Filipina to receive a Walk of Fame star. Other honorees with Filipino heritage, including Bruno Mars, Apl.de.Ap and Rob Schneider, have previously received stars, so FMB News is not describing Salonga as the first person of Filipino heritage to be honored.

sections.heading: Why this matters to Filipinos
paragraphs: The recognition places a Filipina performer whose career was built across Philippine, West End, Broadway, film and concert stages into one of Hollywood's most visible entertainment landmarks.

Beyond celebrity recognition, the milestone carries cultural significance because Salonga's career has repeatedly expanded the visibility of Filipino and Asian performers in international theater and entertainment. The Walk of Fame honor formalizes that legacy in a public institution administered by the Hollywood Chamber of Commerce for the City of Los Angeles.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Salonga is also scheduled to receive the Icon Award at the Manila International Film Festival's closing-night gala in Beverly Hills on September 6.

FMB News will distinguish that separate award from the Walk of Fame ceremony and will only publish another standalone update if it produces a materially new development rather than repeating the same milestone.

audit.socialCaption: Lea Salonga has received the 2,855th star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, becoming the first Filipina to receive the honor. The milestone recognizes a career that has carried Filipino talent from Manila to the West End, Broadway, Disney and stages around the world.
verificationNotes: The Hollywood Chamber of Commerce, which administers the Walk of Fame, directly identifies Salonga as the first Filipina to receive a Hollywood Walk of Fame star and lists the ceremony for September 4, 2026 at 6225 Hollywood Boulevard.
GMA News reported after the ceremony that Salonga officially received the star; Entertainment Weekly independently reported on the completed ceremony and speakers in attendance.
FMB News uses the verified formulation 'first Filipina,' not 'first Filipino.' Other entertainers with Filipino heritage have previously received Walk of Fame stars.
